source: Duarte-Capitani active curated DCbio/DCxtal repository files
source_interface_convention: plain PDB rows are largest interface / EPPIC interface 1; all listed integers are expanded

eligibility.homomer_definition: RCSB polymer entity 1 equals polymer entity 2
eligibility.family_exclusion: remove either partner cluster seen in the full Many-2000 panel at RCSB 30% identity
eligibility.area_band_basis: Duarte et al. 2012 literature-defined crystal/bio overlap region

matching: maximum-cardinality ordered one-to-one assignment within an absolute log(EPPIC area) caliper of 0.05, then minimizing total distance; labels and area used, no coordinates or chemistry descriptors read

locked_models.training_data: hard_improvement_development.tsv only; no refitting or feature selection on DC

primary_test: chemistry-rescue ROC AUC minus area-prior ROC AUC on the complete frozen panel, with 95% family-cluster bootstrap CI
success_rule: chemistry AUC >= 0.65 and lower 95% family-bootstrap bound for delta AUC > 0
